gap: No result ChatGPT got sets the boom mic and the built-in mic side by side on SoundGuys' reader ratings of its mic recordings: 79% of 1,080 votes rated the Shokz OpenComm2 UC Good or Perfect, against 22% of 1,452 votes for the OpenRun Pro 2. None of those results has SoundGuys' measured 17 h 59 min battery run for the OpenComm2 UC either.
standout_why: I checked the two cited RTINGS pages (OpenComm2 2025 review and OpenComm2 2025 vs OpenRun Pro 2), the cited RTINGS OpenMeet UC page, the RTINGS best list, the SoundGuys best list, the SoundGuys OpenRun Pro 2 review and Openear Club. RTINGS locks all its numbers (SpNR, battery, latency, weight) behind a membership, so non-members only see wording: the OpenComm2 mic is 'satisfactory for office use' and the OpenMeet UC mic is 'easily the best of our picks'. The SoundGuys OpenRun Pro 2 review has only that model's poll. The SoundGuys OpenComm2 UC review, which has the 1,080-vote poll and the 17:59 battery run, is not among ChatGPT's results. Openear Club gives only maker claims (8 h listening / 16 h talk for the OpenComm2 UC) and names no measurer. The RTINGS best list does already give 'nine hours' for the OpenRun Pro 2, so that figure isn't new.
decides: It backs ChatGPT's split (OpenComm2 for calls, OpenRun Pro 2 for exercise) and puts numbers on it. Listeners rated the boom-mic OpenComm2 UC Good or Perfect 79% of the time and the built-in-mic OpenRun Pro 2 22% of the time. The OpenComm2 UC also ran 17 h 59 min in SoundGuys' test, against RTINGS' 'nine hours' for the OpenRun Pro 2. The OpenMeet UC (71% Good or Perfect, rated best mic by RTINGS) is the over-the-head alternative ChatGPT cited but showed no card for. For a buyer who mainly makes calls, this points to the OpenComm2 or OpenComm2 UC over the OpenRun Pro 2.

findings.label: SoundGuys battery test
findings.value: 17 h 59 min of playback on one charge (battery score 8.9/10)
findings.source_title: Shokz OpenComm2 UC review - SoundGuys (Jasper Lastoria, Nov 27, 2023)
findings.note: 'measured with our standard test'. The review doesn't state the volume. SoundGuys tested the original OpenComm2 UC (firmware 409-27), not the 2025 refresh. That is more than twice the 8 h listening time Openear Club lists from Shokz.

findings.label: SoundGuys reader poll on the mic recording
findings.value: 1,080 votes: 30% Perfect, 49% Good, 15% Okay, 1% Bad, 4% Awful (79% Good or Perfect)
findings.note: Readers rated a mic recording; this is not an instrument measurement. 79% = 49 + 30. Jasper Lastoria wrote that the boom mic's speech quality 'is excellent'.

findings.label: SoundGuys reader poll on the mic recording
findings.value: 1,452 votes: 2% Perfect, 20% Good, 54% Okay, 18% Bad, 6% Awful (22% Good or Perfect)
findings.source_title: Shokz OpenRun Pro 2 review - SoundGuys (Lil Katz, Nov 13, 2024)
findings.note: Readers rated a recording SoundGuys labels 'non-standardized'. Lil Katz wrote that the mic 'will suffice' in quiet but can 'fall flat' in wind. 22% = 20 + 2.

findings.label: SoundGuys reader poll on the mic recording
findings.value: 218 votes: 27% Perfect, 44% Good, 22% Okay, 3% Bad, 5% Awful (71% Good or Perfect)
findings.source_title: Shokz OpenMeet UC review - SoundGuys (Lil Katz, Jan 7, 2025)
findings.note: Readers rated the recording made in ideal conditions. SoundGuys says it couldn't run its usual battery test on this headset, so its battery figures are subjective. Weight listed as 78 g.

findings.label: SoundGuys battery result
findings.value: 12 hours (battery score 7.9/10, beats 63% of bone conduction headphones)
findings.note: 'lasting 12 hours instead of 10'. The review doesn't give test conditions. SoundGuys lists the weight as 30.3 g.

findings.label: RTINGS battery life
findings.source_title: The 5 Best Bone Conduction And Open-Ear Headphones of 2026 - RTINGS.com
findings.note: From the article text: 'nine hours of battery life'. Page last updated Nov 04, 2026. This is below the 12 h ChatGPT showed. The figure is in this list, which ChatGPT got as a result (not cited).

findings.label: RTINGS mic verdict
findings.value: Rated the best mic among RTINGS' bone conduction and open-ear picks
findings.source_title: The 5 Best Bone Conduction And Open-Ear Headphones of 2026 - RTINGS.com
findings.note: RTINGS: 'The microphone is easily the best of our picks in this article.' RTINGS names it 'best bone conduction for calls'. Its SpNR and noise-handling numbers are locked to members.

findings.label: RTINGS mic verdict vs OpenMeet UC
findings.value: Boom mic 'satisfactory for office use'; the OpenMeet UC 'has a slightly better-performing mic'
findings.note: Test Bench 2.3, updated Jun 23, 2026. RTINGS' SpNR, battery, latency and weight figures are locked to members; I read the review through a text renderer (r.jina.ai) because the page needs JavaScript.
